analysis:
Compared supplied BASE/HEAD tests, the resume patch and all file metadata. scripts/test-provider-release-resolution.py:43-106 now expects unpublished manual dev validation, staging-only master pushes and dev-only dev pushes stamped -dev.branch.N; invalid routes must emit no outputs. Lines 147-202 retain injection, malformed-source and production-tag checks. scripts/test-provider-release-resume.py:135-173 adds dev-only source admission tests requiring verified commits and dev ancestry, rejecting other environments/triggers and preserving master ancestry on master routes. Existing artifact, qualification, production recovery and signing-DAG assertions remain unchanged. These test changes establish no concrete security regression by themselves, and no runtime prompt, key, cache, billing or local availability controls are changed in the supplied source.
Relevant integration concerns are A-005, A-011, A-017, TB-011 and T-054: admitting dev ancestry to an officially signed release lane must not substitute publication or signing for independent serving qualification. The bounded orientation excerpt for scripts/test-release-dev-branch.py describes replacing an experimental self-signed lane with reusable Developer ID signing/notarization and inherited secrets, but its primary unit contains metadata only; its full assertions and workflow enforcement are not supplied here. Integration must examine release-dev-branch.yml, release-provider.yml, provider_release_resume/api.py and resolve-provider-release.sh for trusted workflow/source selection, environment/secret isolation and qualification binding. Also reconcile -dev.branch.N with check-release-version.sh; resolution tests at 204-229 still exercise only the older -dev.N forms. Tests were not executed, and their assertions are not proof of external controls or deployment settings.
